entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Mark Peterson. M-Peterson at webmail dot com.
Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your account now... I see you purchased a VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. Is that the item you're calling about?
Okay. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Are you experiencing a technical fault, or is it more of a personal preference?
It's just not for me. I want to return it.

I understand. Let me just review the specific return policy for your VeloBand. I know for some of our newer products there are very strict rules about sanitation, and for reasons of hygiene, a return after this much time would normally be too late.

Okay, I've just confirmed. It looks like your VeloBand GPS Tracker is covered by our standard 90-day return window. Since it's only been 33 days, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. I can go ahead and process that for you now.
Fine. About time something was simple.

I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file, m-peterson@webmail.com. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Mark. Have a good day.
